packs.title: Bad Game Sprites
packs.name: Bad Game Sprites
packs.description: Pixel Line-Up: identify 20 C64 games from a single sprite. A rogues' gallery of infamous, low-scoring, odd-looking and occasionally unfairly maligned releases.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 01 — Which C64 game is this sprite from?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 fighter sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Zzap!64 gave the C64 conversion 22%.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 02 — Name the game behind these schoolyard suspects.
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 character sprites to identify
questions.reveal: Commodore User gave Grange Hill 1/10; Lemon64 lists a 16% magazine average.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 03 — Which C64 shooter sent this cowboy into battle?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 cowboy sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Zzap!64 gave Gun.Smoke 15%; Lemon64 lists an 18% magazine average.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 04 — Which cartoon licence does this sprite belong to?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 cartoon character sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Zzap!64 gave the Melbourne House Inspector Gadget release 9%.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 05 — Which 2000 AD hero is hiding in these pixels?
options: Dan Dare: Pilot of the Future
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 comic-book hero sprite to identify
questions.reveal: The 1986 Melbourne House Judge Dredd received 13% from Zzap!64.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 06 — Which arcade conversion produced this running hero?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 arcade hero sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Zzap!64 gave Karnov 13%.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 07 — Which game is this heavily armoured gentleman from?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 armoured character sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Lee Enfield: Tournament of Death received 8% from Zzap!64.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 08 — Which cycling game does this rider belong to?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 cyclist sprite to identify
questions.reveal: A divisive one: Your Commodore gave Milk Race 10/10, while Zzap!64 gave it 34%.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 09 — Which side-scrolling oddity stars this Mountie?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 Mountie sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Commodore User gave Mountie Mick's Death Ride 1/10.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 10 — Which martial-arts game owns this tiny ninja?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 ninja sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Commodore User scored The Ninja Master 0/10.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 11 — Which game sent this curious figure into Videoland?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 character sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Not every suspect was universally panned: Lemon64 lists a 67% magazine average for Alice in Videoland.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 12 — Which wrestling game produced this magnificent specimen?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 wrestler sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Lemon64 lists American Tag-Team Wrestling as a 1992 Zeppelin Games wrestling release.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 13 — Which movie tie-in does this trio belong to?
options: The Way of the Exploding Fist
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 movie tie-in character sprites to identify
questions.reveal: Zzap!64 gave Big Trouble in Little China 34%; Commodore User gave it 3/10.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 14 — Which budget game unleashed this elderly menace?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 granny sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Lemon64 currently lists Bionic Granny with a 1.54/10 user rating.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 15 — Which platform game does this pirate belong to?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 pirate sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Zzap!64 gave Booty 16%, although other magazines were much kinder.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 16 — Which single-screen platformer is this miner from?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 miner sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Plot twist: Lemon64 lists a 90% magazine average for China Miner.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 17 — Which circus game is responsible for this performer?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 circus performer sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Lemon64's game list currently puts Circus Circus at roughly 2.2/10 from users.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 18 — Which Stallone movie tie-in is this sprite from?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 action hero sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Zzap!64 gave Cobra 13%; Lemon64 lists a 20% magazine average.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 19 — Which movie licence put this detective on the C64?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 detective sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Commodore Format and Zzap!64 both gave Dick Tracy 11%.

questions.question: PIXEL LINE-UP 20 — One last suspect: which beat-'em-up is this?
questions.imageAlt: Pixel-art C64 beat-em-up sprite to identify
questions.reveal: Zzap!64 gave the original C64 Double Dragon conversion 15%.
